text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident fired: INC-2026-879 — embeddings-eu-prod > 5xx spike. Auto-page to oncall. PD link: <https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-2026-879>

sam: Acked. I'm on it. Pulling metrics and logs now.

sam: Quick summary — 5xx rate jumped ~20% around +00:02, traffic still routed to eu-west-1 embedding pool. Some customers reporting failures via support.

mira: pinging support for customer impact list (they already have a ticket open for acme-corp).

sam: rolling a quick check: `curl -s https://metrics.internal/embed-eu/err_rate` shows 23% 5xx over 5m.

jordan: I can take after initial triage. @sam confirm handoff?

sam: handing to jordan — I want to check autoscaler/queue behavior first, then jordan can own mitigation and PD notes.

sam: running tail on worker logs to see stack traces:
```
kubectl -n prod-eu logs -l app=embeddings-worker --tail=200 | grep ERROR | head
```

sam: seeing a lot of `KVCacheEvictionError` + transient serialization errors on worker-3. Might be memory pressure + a bad rollout earlier.

incident-bot: Reminder — auto-escalation in 6m if not acknowledged/claimed by second line.

jordan: grabbing worker-3 pod logs, looking at OOMs and GC. Also checking node-level memory.

lee: heads-up to account execs: acme-corp and beta-client seeing elevated failures. I can draft customer note once we have ETA.

jordan: confirmed worker-3 OOMs ~ 00:03 and repeated restarts. Pod CPU ok but RSS spikes. Likely a memory regression in latest image tag `emb-v3.7.2`.

sam: can we try a quick scale up to reduce queue pressure while we investigate?

jordan: doing a hot scale and cordon of problematic pod to stop restart churn:
```
kubectl scale deployment embeddings-worker -n prod-eu --replicas=6
kubectl cordon embeddings-worker-3-pod-xyz
```

jordan: scaled to 6, cordoned the flaky pod, new pods spinning up. Monitoring.

pagerbot: PD incident updated — acknowledged by sam, assigned to jordan. Next auto-escalation disabled.

mira: support updated customers list and put ACME on notice. They reported 40 failed calls in last 10m.

sam: monitoring error rate after scale — initial drop from 23% -> 9% within 90s. Good sign.

jordan: I see 5xxs decreasing and avg latency stable. Killing the flaky pod handled immediate restart churn. Suspect regression in `emb-v3.7.2` memory allocation path. Will pin rollout to `emb-v3.7.1` for eu.

jordan: rolling back image on eu deployment:
```
kubectl set image deployment/embeddings-worker embeddings-worker=registry/redwood/emb:v3.7.1 -n prod-eu
```

lee: status for execs: telling ACME we implemented scaling + rollback, errors are trending down, ETA for final confirmation 20m.

sam: continuing to watch graphs (errors, p95 latency, pod restarts). If stable for 25m we can close PD.

incident-bot: Note added to PD: autoscale applied + rollback to v3.7.1; postmortem owner needed.

jordan: error rate now 3.2% over 5m and pod restarts stopped. I'll keep it until stable 30m and then hand off to infra watch for day shift.

mira: assigning postmortem owner — @jordan will own the RCA and timeline. I'll help with customer comms.

sam: great work everyone. After stabilization please include the affected commit/PR in the postmortem and add mitigations (circuit-breaker on mem growth, alert on pod OOMs earlier).

jordan: noted — will include memory profiling, CI load test gap, and an action to block production rollout until memory regression tests pass.

pagerbot: PD incident status changed to monitoring.

lee: sending short customer update now.

jordan: marking intent to resolve in 30m if metrics hold. Will close PD and create follow-up doc: https://confluence.internal/r/redwood/INC-2026-879-postmortem

sam: once PD closed, please post an internal postmortem draft in #postmortems and tag eng-runtime + eng-ml.

incident-bot: Incident resolved by jordan; PD incident closed at 2753220280. Follow-up: postmortem required.

jordan: closing thread — will publish timeline and RCA within 48h. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
